title: The Call of Abram

questions.question: What did God tell Abram to leave?
questions.explanation: Genesis 12:1: "Go from your country and your kindred and your father's house."

questions.question: What did God promise to make Abram?
questions.explanation: Genesis 12:2: "I will make of you a great nation."

questions.question: Where did Abram go during a famine?
questions.explanation: Genesis 12:10: Abram went down to Egypt because of the famine.

questions.question: Who went with Abram when he left Haran?
questions.explanation: Genesis 12:4-5: Abram took Sarai and Lot with him.

questions.question: How old was Abram when he left Haran?
questions.explanation: Genesis 12:4: "Abram was seventy-five years old when he departed from Haran."

questions.question: What did Abram say about Sarai in Egypt?
questions.explanation: Genesis 12:13: Abram asked Sarai to say she was his sister.

questions.question: What happened to Pharaoh when he took Sarai?
questions.explanation: Genesis 12:17: The LORD afflicted Pharaoh and his house with great plagues.

questions.question: Where did Abram first build an altar in Canaan?
options: At the oak of Moreh at Shechem
questions.correctAnswer: At the oak of Moreh at Shechem
questions.explanation: Genesis 12:6-7: At Shechem, at the oak of Moreh, Abram built an altar.

questions.question: What did God promise to give Abram's offspring?
questions.explanation: Genesis 12:7: "To your offspring I will give this land."

questions.question: What was in the land when Abram arrived?
questions.explanation: Genesis 12:6: "At that time the Canaanites were in the land."

questions.question: What blessing would come through Abram to all families?
questions.explanation: Genesis 12:3: "in you all the families of the earth shall be blessed."

questions.question: Where did Abram pitch his tent between two cities?
questions.explanation: Genesis 12:8: He pitched his tent with Bethel on the west and Ai on the east.

questions.question: What did Pharaoh give Abram because of Sarai?
options: Sheep, oxen, donkeys, servants, and camels
questions.correctAnswer: Sheep, oxen, donkeys, servants, and camels
questions.explanation: Genesis 12:16: Pharaoh gave Abram livestock and servants for Sarai's sake.

questions.question: What happened after Pharaoh discovered the truth about Sarai?
options: He sent Abram away with all he had
questions.correctAnswer: He sent Abram away with all he had
questions.explanation: Genesis 12:19-20: Pharaoh sent Abram away with his wife and all that he had.

questions.question: What would happen to those who cursed Abram according to God's promise?
questions.explanation: Genesis 12:3: "him who dishonors you I will curse."

key_verse_text: 'And I will make of you a great nation, and I will bless you and make your name great, so that you will be a blessing.'
